description: This file is a script that performs static analysis on other source files, specifically looking for certain function calls related to pairing store usage and account IDs. It imports TypeScript utilities and custom helper modules, and provides a main function that collects and reports violations in source code related to pairing store conventions.

methods.name: isUndefinedLikeExpression
methods.description: Checks if a node represents an 'undefined' or 'null' literal expression.

methods.name: hasRequiredAccountIdProperty
methods.description: Determines if an object literal expression has an 'accountId' property with a valid initializer.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Analyzes the content of a source file to find specific API usage violations related to pairing store calls.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that collects violations across source files and reports any unscoped pairing-store calls.
